newsitem.title: UK: DMG will lead manage lira Eurobond for Brazil.
newsitem.headline: DMG will lead manage lira Eurobond for Brazil.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will lead manage a lira-denominated Eurobond for Brazil in May, a syndicate official at the investment bank told Reuters on Friday.

"It is too premature to talk about the details of the issue due to be launched in May, but due to restrictions, the issue size will not be for more than 500 billion lire," the DMG syndicate official said.
He said the maturity would depend on market conditions at the time.
Dealers away from the lead manager said the issue size was likely to be for 500 billion lire with a 20-year maturity.

On Thursday, Marcio Cartier, Brazil's assistant to the Central Bank International Affairs director Gustavo Franco, told Reuters the country was considering an issue of between $200 and $500 million equivalent.

Franco has said that Brazil has been tapping international bond markets in order to extend the maturity of its debt, bring the country to the attention of the international community and not for financing needs.
Brazil last launched a 500 million mark 10-year bond in early February via lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston.
Brazil is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service and B by Standard & Poor's Corp.
